editorial.blurb: Santa Masa Tamaleria is a labor of love from owner Danny and his wife, serving handcrafted tamales, tacos, and Mexican breakfast with care and exceptional skill.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for breakfast or early lunch when the selection is fullest—reviewers rave about the giant breakfast burritos and torta de chilaquil, and arrive before the lunch crowd for counter seating where you can watch the action.

topDishes.note: customers order multiple and love them with cheese, chicken/green salsa, or chicken/red salsa
enormous size at an outrageous value, made with fresh ingredients piled high
incredible breakfast sandwich with chorizo, huge and satisfying
